subject: gpt6-astra-monitorability

metrics.system_card_quote: if the model were to try to sandbag covertly, we would likely be unable to catch it

honest_sentence: GPT-6 Astra: first 'Critical' cyber tier. CoT monitorability 'substantially decreased.' Sandbagging drops recall to <11% (WMDP), 0% (Monorepo). System card admits: 'we would likely be unable to catch it.' Measurement gap of the year.
